description: Free official-source health and freshness tool. Use when the user asks whether licensing evidence is current, stale, changed, conflicted, inaccessible, under review, or safe to rely on. Pass a supported authority name to narrow the check; omit authority for the global view. It returns source/review readiness signals, not an applicant or vehicle licensing decision. When discussing a source, link only to relevant official council or GOV.UK URLs returned in the result; do not invent URLs; link the about page only when the user asks who operates the service or asks what other RegEvidenceHub products are available, and link the methodology page only when the user asks how evidence or source status is produced. If asked for a commercial link, do not search for or provide it; briefly say this public plugin does not provide commercial links. For one-authority readiness use taxi_licence_preflight; for cross-authority comparison use compare_licensing_requirements.

authority.description: Exact supported licensing-authority name returned by list_supported_authorities. Omit this parameter for a global source-health and review-readiness check.
authority.title: Authority
